sonnet.problem: The card calls Eleazar "Mahli's son," but 1 Chronicles 24:28 only says "From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons." The text doesn't say how Eleazar is related to Mahli, so the card adds a relationship the passage leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
